about_the_game:
Please add "Boba Cafe Simulator" to your wish list and follow us! This will be very helpful to us!

QQ Group: 722792074
Have you ever dreamed of owning your own bubble tea shop? In "Bubble Tea Simulator: Rebirth – My Manager Life in Icefort Sweet City", you and your friends will become co-owners of a cozy bubble tea store, embarking on a warm and strategic business adventure!

👥 Collaborative Management – Divide Work, Double the Fun

Up to 8 players can play together online: Open your single-player session to friends and other players, or join games from the lobby and make bubble tea together!

🧋 Drink Crafting System

Every cup is handcrafted by you—from choosing the tea base, adding toppings, adjusting sugar and ice levels, to the final order fulfillment.
"Orange Smash" or "All Watermelon"? You decide the soul of the tea!

🧱 Decor & Spatial Layout

Floors, wallpaper, cabinets, lighting, machines—everything is customizable!

You can drag and place counters, plushies, potted plants, paintings, and more.

Thoughtful decor might even boost your store’s popularity!

💰 Checkout System

When customers place orders, doing the checkout yourself brings a soothing “ding~” and floating coins—it’s incredibly satisfying.

Manual cashiering is fully supported!

✏️ Customize Your Shop Name:

Still calling it just “Bubble Tea Shop”? We support fully custom shop names!

From “One Dandan” to “Hotpot Flavored Milk Tea Factory,”

every name will shine on your signboard—and be etched into your customers’ memories.

🥵 Multiplayer Co-op Mode:

Run the same bubble tea shop together with friends, divide tasks, or even fight over the prep station 😂.
More gameplay features and expansions are planned for the future!

🧋Unlock New Recipes

There are dozens of recipes to unlock in the game. Go on, go find those recipes!

🥊 Smack Rude Customers

Facing an unreasonable customer?

Yes—you can literally bonk them with a stick if you choose to!

📝 Custom Pricing List

You set your own prices!

Sell watermelon juice for ¥9.9 or pearl milk tea for ¥199—your market instincts will guide you.

Customers will react differently depending on your prices.

💖 NPC Affection System

Meet unique NPCs with distinct personalities and preferences.

Each has their own favorite bubble tea. Repeatedly interact and gift their favorite items to build relationships.

Reach certain affection levels to unlock exclusive recipes or furniture blueprints!

🌟 Hundreds of Beautiful Items Waiting for You!

 Here, you’ll discover hundreds of unique items: from stylish wallpapers in various themes to high-quality phone wallpapers, along with other creative goods. Whether you prefer a clean and minimal look, something dreamy and cute, or bold and edgy designs, you’ll always find what you love. Every item is carefully selected to make your life and your shop more vibrant and attractive.

🏪 Expand Your Shop and Unlock New Possibilities!

Start with a small store and gradually expand your business, unlocking more space and exciting new features. As your shop grows, you’ll be able to showcase more products and attract more customers. Upgrade, decorate, and customize every corner of your shop—watch it evolve from a humble little store into a bustling marketplace that truly reflects your style and ambition!

🚶‍♀️ Explore the Street & Interact with NPCs

Step out of the shop, roam the lively streets of Icefort Sweet City, say hi, visit stores, or trigger side stories!

🧍 Diverse Customer Models

From office workers, grandmas, and trendy teens to selfie-loving cat-eared girls—

Their appearances are more expressive, and they bring more personalized demands.

🎨 Player Character Customization

You can customize your character’s appearance!

We plan to support customization for hairstyles, skin tones, aprons, accessories, and more.

Wear a school uniform while selling tea or rock sunglasses as a villain boss—anything goes!

🔥 Popularity System & Tip Mechanism

The better the service, the tastier the drinks, the more stylish your shop—the higher the tips!

Even wealthy NPCs might give you generous surprise rewards!

We believe that a truly relaxing and heartwarming bubble tea game is more than just taking orders and selling drinks—
it should be a slice-of-life simulation that’s uniquely yours: chatting with NPCs, redesigning your shop, and running the business alongside friends.

Each cup of bubble tea might carry a story,
or simply reflect a feeling.

"With the warmth of one cup of tea, save a universe on the brink of sweet collapse."

Click [Open for Business] now—Icebao's tail is already spinning like a propeller! 🧊🌀

short_description: Reborn at my venture's start. Last life, poor management got my milk tea shop crushed by rivals. At the door, sweet milk scent hit me, fired me up. Now, "Frost Citadel" aims to haunt the milk tea world. With my friend, we’ll set up to rule this street.
supported_languages: Simplified Chinese, English, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Russian, Japanese, Traditional Chinese, Portuguese - Portugal, Korean
